subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

All his attempts to save the wounded animal turned out to be __futile__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Unsuccessful**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Futile **means incapable of producing any useful result. (व्यर्थ)

 
 
• **Example**: *His attempts to fix the antique watch were futile.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Unsuccessful **means not achieving the desired outcome or failing to accomplish a goal. (असफल)
 
 
• **Example**: *Despite her hard work, the business venture was ultimately unsuccessful.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Foresightful**: Having the ability to anticipate or predict future events and outcomes. (दूरदर्शी)
 
• **Mirthful**: Full of joy, happiness, and laughter. (आनंदित)
 
• **Worthwhile**: Valuable, significant, or deserving of time, effort, or attention due to the benefits or rewards it brings. (सार्थक)
